title: Approximate tangent spaces depend only on the set near the point
statement: Let m, N ∈ ℕ, S, T ⊆ ℝ^N, x ∈ ℝ^N, ε > 0 and let P be a linear subspace of ℝ^N. Suppose S ∩ B̆_ε(x) = T ∩ B̆_ε(x) (open ball). If P is the approximate tangent space of T at x in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, Def. 1.4 with Hᵐ := μHE[m] (Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt m T x P), then P is the approximate tangent space of S at x (Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt m S x P).
lean_statement: ∀ (m N : ℕ) (S T : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N))) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) (ε : ℝ) (P : Submodule ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N))), 0 < ε → S ∩ ball x ε = T ∩ ball x ε → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt m T x P → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt m S x P
